Rinas

Overview

Rinas is an Ingos sorcerer whose prospects have suffered under Diera’s privileged position. He offers his talents for the search for the Princess and hopes for compensation later. At parting, he regards the end of Diera’s dominance as reward enough. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Diera’s privileged position and the governor’s ban on competing magicians explain why Rinas offers help in the Princess investigation. He postpones any fee, trusting that Zak’s apparent poverty will not last. In their farewell, he treats the end of Diera’s dominance as sufficient payment. His motive is therefore tied to the politics of Ingos as well as the opportunity to travel with Zak. [1, 2, 3, 4]
